description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint within the OrangeHRM recruitment module, specifically for marking a candidate interview as failed. It includes validation rules, API documentation annotations, and references external classes for workflow states and interview entities.

classes.name: CandidateMarkingInterviewFailAPI
classes.description: API class to handle marking a candidate interview as failed within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It implements validation rules and specifies the resulting workflow state.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating the interview failure status, including validation for interview ID and entity existence.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the workflow state constant corresponding to 'interview failed' status.
